title: UI Oddity Scan
tagline: Finds what's off on a page, pinned on screenshots.
ability: Inventories one page first, then flags what's odd: a fact said three times, sections that repeat each other, stray text, placeholder copy, misalignment and off-topic images. Each is pinned on a crop.
flavor: Never pad with invented nitpicks or out-of-scope advice to look thorough.
